stem: In right triangle $DEF$, angle $E$ is the right angle, $DE = 20$, $EF = 21$, and $DF = 29$. What is the value of $\cos F$?
explanation_en:
The hypotenuse is $\overline{DF}$, opposite the right angle $E$. The leg adjacent to angle $F$ is $\overline{EF}$. So $\cos F = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \frac{EF}{DF} = \frac{21}{29}$. Choice C is correct.

Choice A ($\frac{20}{29}$) is $\sin F$, which uses the opposite leg. Choice B ($\frac{20}{21}$) is $\tan F$. Choice D ($\frac{21}{20}$) is $\tan D$, the reciprocal of $\tan F$.
explanation_uz:
Gipotenuza — to‘g‘ri burchak $E$ qarshisidagi $\overline{DF}$. $F$ burchakka yopishgan katet $\overline{EF}$. Demak $\cos F = \frac{\text{yopishgan katet}}{\text{gipotenuza}} = \frac{EF}{DF} = \frac{21}{29}$. To‘g‘ri javob C.

A ($\frac{20}{29}$) — bu $\sin F$, qarshidagi katet olingan. B ($\frac{20}{21}$) — bu $\tan F$. D ($\frac{21}{20}$) — bu $\tan D$, ya’ni $\tan F$ ning teskarisi.

stem: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length 26 and one leg of length 10. What is the length of the other leg?
explanation_en:
By the Pythagorean theorem, $10^2 + b^2 = 26^2$, so $b^2 = 676 - 100 = 576$ and $b = 24$.

If you got about 27.86 (that is, $\sqrt{776}$), you added the squares as if 26 were a leg instead of the hypotenuse. If you got 16, you subtracted the lengths without squaring.
explanation_uz:
Pifagor teoremasiga ko‘ra $10^2 + b^2 = 26^2$, demak $b^2 = 676 - 100 = 576$ va $b = 24$.

Agar taxminan 27.86 (ya’ni $\sqrt{776}$) chiqqan bo‘lsa, 26 gipotenuza emas, katet deb olinib kvadratlar qo‘shilgan. Agar 16 chiqqan bo‘lsa, uzunliklar kvadratga ko‘tarilmasdan ayirilgan.

stem: An isosceles right triangle has two legs that are each 7 centimeters long. What is the length, in centimeters, of the hypotenuse?
explanation_en:
In a $45^\circ$-$45^\circ$-$90^\circ$ triangle the hypotenuse is $\sqrt{2}$ times a leg, so it is $7\sqrt{2}$. Using the Pythagorean theorem: $\sqrt{7^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{98} = 7\sqrt{2}$. Choice A is correct.

Choice B ($7\sqrt{3}$) uses the $30^\circ$-$60^\circ$-$90^\circ$ ratio. Choice C ($14$) adds the legs. Choice D ($49$) is $7^2$, the square of one leg.
explanation_uz:
$45^\circ$-$45^\circ$-$90^\circ$ uchburchakda gipotenuza katetdan $\sqrt{2}$ marta uzun, ya’ni $7\sqrt{2}$. Pifagor teoremasi bilan: $\sqrt{7^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{98} = 7\sqrt{2}$. To‘g‘ri javob A.

B ($7\sqrt{3}$) — $30^\circ$-$60^\circ$-$90^\circ$ nisbati ishlatilgan. C ($14$) — katetlar qo‘shilgan. D ($49$) — bitta katetning kvadrati, $7^2$.

stem: An equilateral triangle has sides of length 10. What is the height of the triangle (the length of the perpendicular segment from one vertex to the opposite side)?
explanation_en:
The height splits the equilateral triangle into two $30^\circ$-$60^\circ$-$90^\circ$ triangles, each with hypotenuse 10 and shorter leg $\frac{10}{2} = 5$. The height is the longer leg: $5\sqrt{3}$. Check: $\sqrt{10^2 - 5^2} = \sqrt{75} = 5\sqrt{3}$. Choice C is correct.

Choice A ($5$) is the shorter leg, half the base. Choice B ($5\sqrt{2}$) uses the $45^\circ$-$45^\circ$-$90^\circ$ ratio. Choice D ($10\sqrt{3}$) multiplies the full side, instead of half of it, by $\sqrt{3}$.
explanation_uz:
Balandlik teng tomonli uchburchakni ikkita $30^\circ$-$60^\circ$-$90^\circ$ uchburchakka bo‘ladi; har birining gipotenuzasi 10, qisqa kateti $\frac{10}{2} = 5$. Balandlik uzun katet: $5\sqrt{3}$. Tekshiruv: $\sqrt{10^2 - 5^2} = \sqrt{75} = 5\sqrt{3}$. To‘g‘ri javob C.

A ($5$) — qisqa katet, asosning yarmi. B ($5\sqrt{2}$) — $45^\circ$-$45^\circ$-$90^\circ$ nisbati ishlatilgan. D ($10\sqrt{3}$) — tomonning yarmi emas, butuni $\sqrt{3}$ ga ko‘paytirilgan.

stem: In right triangle $RST$, angle $T$ is the right angle and $\sin R = \frac{5}{13}$. What is the value of $\tan S$?
explanation_en:
$\sin R = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \frac{ST}{RS} = \frac{5}{13}$, so we can take $ST = 5$ and $RS = 13$. By the Pythagorean theorem, $RT = \sqrt{13^2 - 5^2} = 12$. For angle $S$, the opposite leg is $RT$ and the adjacent leg is $ST$, so $\tan S = \frac{RT}{ST} = \frac{12}{5}$. Enter 12/5 or 2.4.

If you got $\frac{5}{12}$, you found $\tan R$ instead of $\tan S$. If you got $\frac{12}{13}$, you found $\cos R$ (which equals $\sin S$).
explanation_uz:
$\sin R = \frac{\text{qarshidagi katet}}{\text{gipotenuza}} = \frac{ST}{RS} = \frac{5}{13}$, demak $ST = 5$ va $RS = 13$ deb olish mumkin. Pifagor teoremasiga ko‘ra $RT = \sqrt{13^2 - 5^2} = 12$. $S$ burchak uchun qarshidagi katet $RT$, yopishgan katet $ST$, shuning uchun $\tan S = \frac{RT}{ST} = \frac{12}{5}$. 12/5 yoki 2.4 kiriting.

Agar $\frac{5}{12}$ chiqqan bo‘lsa, siz $\tan S$ o‘rniga $\tan R$ ni topgansiz. Agar $\frac{12}{13}$ chiqqan bo‘lsa, bu $\cos R$ (u $\sin S$ ga teng).

stem: A surveyor stands on level ground 40 meters from the base of a vertical tower. The angle of elevation from the ground at the surveyor’s position to the top of the tower is $30^\circ$. What is the height, in meters, of the tower?
explanation_en:
The tower, the ground, and the line of sight form a right triangle. The 40-meter distance is the leg adjacent to the $30^\circ$ angle, and the height $h$ is the opposite leg. So $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{40}$, and $h = 40 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{40\sqrt{3}}{3}$ meters (about 23.1 meters). Choice B is correct.

Choice A ($20$) is $40 \sin 30^\circ$, which treats 40 as the hypotenuse. Choice C ($20\sqrt{3}$) is $40 \cos 30^\circ$, also treating 40 as the hypotenuse. Choice D ($40\sqrt{3}$) is $40 \tan 60^\circ$, using the wrong angle.
explanation_uz:
Minora, yer va ko‘rish chizig‘i to‘g‘ri burchakli uchburchak hosil qiladi. 40 metrlik masofa $30^\circ$ burchakka yopishgan katet, balandlik $h$ esa qarshidagi katet. Demak $\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{40}$ va $h = 40 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{40\sqrt{3}}{3}$ metr (taxminan 23.1 metr). To‘g‘ri javob B.

A ($20$) — bu $40 \sin 30^\circ$, 40 gipotenuza deb olingan. C ($20\sqrt{3}$) — bu $40 \cos 30^\circ$, bunda ham 40 gipotenuza deb olingan. D ($40\sqrt{3}$) — bu $40 \tan 60^\circ$, noto‘g‘ri burchak olingan.

stem: In right triangle $ABC$, angle $C$ is the right angle. The altitude from $C$ meets hypotenuse $\overline{AB}$ at point $D$, with $AD = 4$ and $DB = 9$. What is the length of $\overline{BC}$?
explanation_en:
The altitude to the hypotenuse creates triangles similar to the original triangle. Triangle $CBD$ is similar to triangle $ABC$ (they share angle $B$ and each has a right angle), so $\frac{BC}{AB} = \frac{DB}{BC}$, which gives $BC^2 = DB \cdot AB = 9 \cdot 13 = 117$. So $BC = \sqrt{117} = 3\sqrt{13}$. Check: $CD = \sqrt{4 \cdot 9} = 6$, and $CD^2 + DB^2 = 36 + 81 = 117$. Choice D is correct.

Choice A ($6$) is the altitude $CD$. Choice B ($2\sqrt{13}$) is $AC$, the other leg, from $AC^2 = AD \cdot AB = 52$. Choice C ($9$) is $DB$, which is only part of the hypotenuse, not a side of triangle $ABC$.
explanation_uz:
Gipotenuzaga tushirilgan balandlik dastlabki uchburchakka o‘xshash uchburchaklar hosil qiladi. $CBD$ uchburchak $ABC$ uchburchakka o‘xshash ($B$ burchak umumiy va ikkalasida to‘g‘ri burchak bor), demak $\frac{BC}{AB} = \frac{DB}{BC}$, ya’ni $BC^2 = DB \cdot AB = 9 \cdot 13 = 117$. Shuning uchun $BC = \sqrt{117} = 3\sqrt{13}$. Tekshiruv: $CD = \sqrt{4 \cdot 9} = 6$ va $CD^2 + DB^2 = 36 + 81 = 117$. To‘g‘ri javob D.

A ($6$) — bu $CD$ balandlik. B ($2\sqrt{13}$) — bu boshqa katet $AC$, $AC^2 = AD \cdot AB = 52$ dan. C ($9$) — bu $DB$, gipotenuzaning faqat bir qismi, $ABC$ uchburchakning tomoni emas.

stem: In triangle $ABC$, $AB = AC = 17$ and $BC = 16$. What is the value of $\tan B$?
explanation_en:
Draw the altitude from $A$ to $\overline{BC}$, meeting it at $M$. Because the triangle is isosceles with $AB = AC$, this altitude bisects $\overline{BC}$, so $BM = 8$. In right triangle $ABM$, $AM = \sqrt{17^2 - 8^2} = \sqrt{225} = 15$. Then $\tan B = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}} = \frac{AM}{BM} = \frac{15}{8}$. Enter 15/8 or 1.875.

If you got $\frac{8}{15}$, you inverted the ratio (that is $\tan \angle BAM$). If you got $\frac{15}{16}$, you used all of $\overline{BC}$ as the adjacent side even though the right angle is at $M$, the midpoint. If you got $\frac{8}{17}$, you found $\cos B$.
explanation_uz:
$A$ dan $\overline{BC}$ ga balandlik tushiramiz, u $\overline{BC}$ ni $M$ nuqtada kesadi. Uchburchak teng yonli ($AB = AC$) bo‘lgani uchun bu balandlik $\overline{BC}$ ni teng ikkiga bo‘ladi, ya’ni $BM = 8$. $ABM$ to‘g‘ri burchakli uchburchakda $AM = \sqrt{17^2 - 8^2} = \sqrt{225} = 15$. U holda $\tan B = \frac{\text{qarshidagi katet}}{\text{yopishgan katet}} = \frac{AM}{BM} = \frac{15}{8}$. 15/8 yoki 1.875 kiriting.

Agar $\frac{8}{15}$ chiqqan bo‘lsa, nisbat teskari olingan (bu $\tan \angle BAM$). Agar $\frac{15}{16}$ chiqqan bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri burchak o‘rtadagi $M$ nuqtada bo‘lsa ham yopishgan katet sifatida butun $\overline{BC}$ olingan. Agar $\frac{8}{17}$ chiqqan bo‘lsa, siz $\cos B$ ni topgansiz.
